summary: Mingo County, WV lookout (US 1639) erected 1961 under STEP; 1963 fire approach and observer's fire line; registered 2017; firelookout.org lists it as gone.

facts.design: Steel tower with several buildings at the lookout post
facts.status_note: firelookout.org lists 'Tower Gone'; the register gives no removal date or description

events.note: Erected under the State Temporary Employment Program (STEP), per the register and the Forest Lookouts page
Observer Emory Hypes on duty at the lookout post, per a November 1963 newspaper account

Item dated November 1, 1963: a forest fire spotter was routed from his lookout tower on a Thursday night; observer climbed down and dug a fire line around the property with a rake, and the flames stopped at the line
Registered January 26, 2017 as US 1639, WV 30; nominated by Brian Powell

notes_for_editor: The register and the Forest Lookouts page agree on the 1961 STEP erection. Only one incident (1963) was found. No removal date, current photo or description of the site was found; one web search returned nothing new. The 'access unknown' brief value is kept, so no access fact is given. The 1963 account is the only design detail and it is from a newspaper quote on the Forest Lookouts page.
